description: This PHP class defines validation rules for timesheet entry parameters within the OrangeHRM project. It validates arrays of time entry data, checking for required fields, date formats, date ranges, durations, and the validity of associated project and activity IDs.

classes.name: TimesheetEntriesParamRule
classes.description: A validation rule class that ensures correctness and completeness of timesheet entry parameters, such as project IDs, activity IDs, dates, and durations, for the specified timesheet.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the rule with a specific timesheet ID to validate against.

methods.name: getApiDateRule
methods.description: Returns an instance of ApiDate used for validating date fields.

methods.name: getTimeRule
methods.description: Returns an instance of Time used for validating time duration fields.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs comprehensive validation on a provided array of timesheet entries, checking field presence, correctness, and consistency with existing timesheet data.
